fields.project: Where the Conference is now would you be able to put the attached poster and the following information
fields.task_description:
SAVE THE DATE!

We are delighted to announce that CPotential is hosting the National Conductive Education Conference 2027, in association with the Professional Conductors' Association - UK - Conductive Education on Saturday 13 March 2027 at The Building Centre, London.

This year's theme: ✨ Integrations and Innovations ✨

Join us to explore the future of Conductive Education, interdisciplinary collaboration, and new opportunities across healthcare, education and community services.

📆 Saturday 13 March 2027
📍 The Building Centre, London WC1E 7BT
🥂 Friday 12 March 2027 — Cheese & Wine Reception hosted by Irwin Mitchell, London EC4Y 0AY

We will welcome around 150 delegates from across the UK, including Conductors, Occupational Therapists, Physiotherapists, educators, researchers, case managers and professionals working in neurological rehabilitation and disability.

The programme will feature keynote speakers and a unique round-table discussion bringing together perspectives from healthcare, Conductive Education, case management, the legal sector and people with lived experience of disability.

We are delighted to have the support of our wonderful sponsors:

👏 Irwin Mitchell (Irwin Mitchell)
👏 Slater and Gordon (Slater and Gordon Lawyers - UK)
👏 Active Care Group (Active Care Group)

📩 Interested in attending? Register your interest by emailing Orsi Farkas at ofarkas@cpotential.org.uk.

Further conference details and ticket information will be shared soon.

We can’t wait to welcome the Conductive Education community to London in 2027! 🎉

fields.project: Outstanding Contribution to Conductive Education Award 2027
fields.task_description:
We are delighted to announce that nominations are now open for the 2027 Outstanding Contribution to Conductive Education Award.
This award recognises an individual who has made an exceptional and lasting contribution to Conductive Education. We want to celebrate someone whose commitment, dedication and passion have helped to make a positive difference to the lives of children, young people, adults, families or the wider Conductive Education community.
We welcome nominations for individuals who have demonstrated outstanding commitment through their professional practice, leadership, innovation, advocacy, research, education, or contribution to the development and recognition of Conductive Education.
Who will you nominate?
This could be a conductor, assistant, professional, researcher, advocate, volunteer or another individual who has made a significant contribution to our field.
📅 Nominations open: 17 October 2026
📅 Nominations close: 15 January 2027
🏆 Shortlist and winner announced: PCA Conference 2027
We encourage you to take this opportunity to recognise someone whose contribution deserves to be celebrated.
To request a nomination form, please email:
info@pca-ce.org 
We look forward to celebrating the inspiring people who continue to contribute to the development, strength and future of Conductive Education.
